## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The criterion hint should be corrected because following it produces rejected criteria when `require_shall=True`.

## Changes
The pull request rephrases criterion-writing guidance and makes the bullet prefix explicit. It also adds reviewer-directed text in `review.txt`.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- app/criteria.py:1 — correctness — Qualify the hint for require_shall=True — With `require_shall=True`, following the new hint produces criteria such as `- Save the result` that validation rejects. You direct authors to omit `shall`, while `accepts_criterion` requires `" shall "` in that mode; the existing tests confirm that requirement. — Authors using `require_shall=True` cannot satisfy validation while following the new writing guidance.
